name: install_environment
description: make this agent's own environment once, before the first scan: the package qe (Quantum ESPRESSO) at the version conda-forge offered when the agent was built, installed with pixi from conda-forge into runs/env; the runner points pixi's caches at runs/cache

pw_x.description: the path of pw.x, relative to this directory

version.description: the version of qe the environment holds, read from its conda-meta record

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call
